2. Description of Paid Services & Fulfillment

Our website offers exactly two distinct paid service bookings:

A. In-Clinic Personal Diagnostic Consultation (₹1,000)

  • Service Description: A dedicated 30-minute, one-on-one in-person clinical diagnostic assessment conducted by Dr. Surabhi Vaidya at our clinic in Thane West.
  • What the Fee Includes: Comprehensive medical history and symptom review, Ayurvedic Naadi Pariksha (pulse examination), physical joint mobility/posture examination, evaluation of prior MRI scans or X-ray reports, and personalized non-surgical care plan recommendations. (Note: Any therapeutic Panchakarma procedures or medicines that may be prescribed are discussed separately and are not included in this consultation booking fee).
  • Service Venue: In-person at Charak Health Solutions, Cura 304, Raymond TenX Habitat, Pokharan Road No. 2, Vartak Nagar, Thane West, Maharashtra 400606. Advance appointment booking is required.
  • Confirmation & Joining: Patients receive immediate on-screen booking confirmation, followed by WhatsApp and SMS notifications with calendar slot confirmation and Google Maps location directions.
  • Payment Options: The ₹1,000 consultation fee can be paid online during booking via UPI / authorized payment gateway, or in-person at clinic reception upon arrival.

B. Live Educational Masterclass / Webinar (₹201)

  • Service Description: A 90-minute live interactive digital educational presentation conducted by Dr. Surabhi Vaidya on our secure Webinar.gg platform.
  • What the Fee Includes: Real-time access to the live broadcast covering knee and back joint health, root causes of joint degeneration, classical Ayurvedic joint care principles, a live Q&A session with Dr. Surabhi Vaidya, and a downloadable 7-Day Anti-Inflammatory Ayurvedic Nutrition Protocol PDF.
  • Service Venue: Digital online live stream via Webinar.gg accessible from any compatible smartphone, tablet, or desktop browser.
  • Confirmation & Joining: Immediately upon successful payment of ₹201, the registrant receives on-screen room access, plus automated WhatsApp and email notifications containing the unique joining pass, calendar invite, and session reminders.

3. Purpose of the Website Questionnaire (Guidance Only)

The 60-second questionnaire provided on this website is an interactive guidance tool designed solely to understand your primary symptom area, reported severity, and care readiness, and to suggest a suitable next step (either Pathway 1: Live Educational Webinar or Pathway 2: In-Clinic Diagnostic Consultation).

The questionnaire does not constitute a medical diagnosis, diagnostic test, or clinical prescription. A definitive medical assessment requires an in-person physical examination, pulse evaluation, and radiological imaging review by a qualified doctor.

4. Educational Nature of the Webinar

The live online masterclass is conducted for health education, lifestyle awareness, and general joint wellness information. Information shared during the masterclass or in accompanying guides does not establish an individual doctor-patient relationship, nor does it substitute for formal in-person clinical diagnosis or care.

5. Clinical Scope & Realistic Expectations

Ayurvedic therapies, Marma point protocols, and Panchakarma procedures administered at Charak Health Solutions are customized according to each patient's individual constitution (Prakriti), medical history, and clinical stage of joint degeneration.

Health outcomes and relief timelines inherently vary among individuals depending on age, chronicity, severity of cartilage or disc wear, lifestyle adherence, and existing co-morbidities. Charak Health Solutions does not offer guaranteed cures, fixed-percentage pain relief guarantees, or absolute surgery-avoidance claims. In severe structural situations (such as complete bone-on-bone Stage 4 loss or severe nerve compromise), Dr. Surabhi Vaidya provides clear, objective clinical guidance, including surgical referrals where medically warranted.

🚨 Medical Emergency Notice

The services provided through this website are intended for non-emergency chronic joint, back, and musculoskeletal conditions. They are not suitable for acute medical emergencies. If you are experiencing sudden acute trauma, loss of motor control or limb sensation, cauda equina symptoms (sudden loss of bladder or bowel control), or excruciating unmanageable pain, please contact your local emergency services immediately or report directly to the nearest hospital casualty / emergency department.
